question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The shop (0) was (be) tiny and dark. I (1) ________ (enter) cautiously, noticing that a layer of dust (2) ________ (settle) on every surface. "I (3) ________ (wait) for you," a voice rasped from the corner. An old man (4) ________ (sit) behind a desk, clutching a box. If I (5) ________ (be) braver, I would have asked him how he knew my name. He (6) ________ (open) the lid to reveal a ring that (7) ________ (belong) to my grandfather. I realized then that my journey (8) ________ (only just begin).
explanation: Past tenses: (0) was - past simple description; (1) entered - past simple action; (2) had settled - past perfect; (3) have been waiting - present perfect continuous; (4) was sitting/sat - past continuous/simple; (5) had been - past perfect in conditional; (6) opened - past simple; (7) had belonged - past perfect; (8) had only just begun - past perfect.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The experiment (0) has been (be) a success so far. Until last week, the team (1) ________ (struggle) to stabilize the compound. However, once the temperature (2) ________ (lower) to absolute zero, the molecules (3) ________ (start) to behave predictably. Dr. Aris (4) ________ (believe) that if they (5) ________ (continue) at this pace, they (6) ________ (publish) their findings by June. Currently, the lab (7) ________ (monitor) by security to ensure no data (8) ________ (leak).
explanation: Mixed tenses: (0) has been - present perfect; (1) had been struggling - past perfect continuous; (2) was lowered - past simple passive; (3) started - past simple; (4) believes - present simple; (5) continue - present simple in conditional; (6) will publish - future simple; (7) is being monitored - present continuous passive; (8) leaks - present simple.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The train (0) pulled (pull) out of the station at midnight. By the time I (1) ________ (realize) I was on the wrong platform, the doors (2) ________ (lock) firmly. I (3) ________ (try) to signal the guard, but he (4) ________ (vanish). I (5) ________ (wander) through the carriages for an hour when I suddenly (6) ________ (hear) a faint whistle. I wish I (7) ________ (listen) to the porter's warning earlier. Now, I (8) ________ (trap) in a moving tomb.
explanation: Past narrative: (0) pulled - past simple; (1) realized - past simple; (2) had locked - past perfect; (3) tried - past simple; (4) had vanished - past perfect; (5) had been wandering - past perfect continuous; (6) heard - past simple; (7) had listened - past perfect in wish; (8) am trapped - present simple passive.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The fire (0) raged (rage) through the valley for three days. Before the rain (1) ________ (arrive), nearly half the forest (2) ________ (turn) to ash. The villagers (3) ________ (evacuate) to the nearby hills where they (4) ________ (watch) their homes disappear. If the fire department (5) ________ (act) sooner, the damage (6) ________ (minimize). Now, the community (7) ________ (rebuild) what was lost, hoping that such a tragedy (8) ________ (never recur).
explanation: Past and present: (0) raged - past simple; (1) arrived - past simple; (2) had turned - past perfect; (3) were evacuated - past simple passive; (4) watched - past simple; (5) had acted - past perfect in conditional; (6) would have been minimized - conditional perfect passive; (7) is rebuilding - present continuous; (8) will never recur - future simple.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: She (0) felt (feel) nervous as she walked in. She (1) ________ (prepare) for this interview for months. The panel (2) ________ (consist) of five grim-looking experts. "Why (3) ________ you ________ (choose) this career?" the chairman asked. Before she (4) ________ (can) answer, the phone (5) ________ (ring). It (6) ________ (be) an emergency. The interview (7) ________ (postpone), and she (8) ________ (tell) to come back the following Monday.
explanation: Past narrative with questions: (0) felt - past simple; (1) had been preparing - past perfect continuous; (2) consisted - past simple; (3) did...choose - past simple question; (4) could - past modal; (5) rang - past simple; (6) was - past simple; (7) was postponed - past simple passive; (8) was told - past simple passive.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: By the time the race (0) started (start), Arjun (1) ________ (warm) up for nearly two hours. He (2) ________ (know) that if he (3) ________ (win) this gold medal, he (4) ________ (become) a national hero. He (5) ________ (train) relentlessly since he was twelve. As the whistle (6) ________ (blow), he (7) ________ (sprint) forward. Years of hard work (8) ________ (finally pay) off.
explanation: Past narrative with conditionals: (0) started - past simple; (1) had been warming - past perfect continuous; (2) knew - past simple; (3) won - past simple in conditional; (4) would become - conditional; (5) had been training - past perfect continuous; (6) blew - past simple; (7) sprinted - past simple; (8) were finally paying - past continuous.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The ice (0) is (be) dangerously thin this year. The explorers (1) ________ (warn) by the locals before they (2) ________ (set) out. Had they (3) ________ (heed) the advice, they (4) ________ (not be) in this crisis now. One of the sledges (5) ________ (sink) into the slush yesterday. They (6) ________ (wait) for a rescue chopper for ten hours now. If the wind (7) ________ (pick) up, the mission (8) ________ (abandon).
explanation: Mixed tenses with conditionals: (0) is - present simple; (1) were warned - past simple passive; (2) set - past simple; (3) heeded - past perfect in inverted conditional; (4) would not be - conditional; (5) sank - past simple; (6) have been waiting - present perfect continuous; (7) picks - present simple in conditional; (8) will be abandoned - future passive.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The museum (0) discovered (discover) the theft at dawn. The masterpiece (1) ________ (remove) from its frame with surgical precision. The security cameras (2) ________ (tamper) with the previous night. The police (3) ________ (suspect) that an insider (4) ________ (help) the thieves. Unless the painting (5) ________ (recover) soon, the curator (6) ________ (resign). Currently, every exit (7) ________ (watch) by undercover agents.
explanation: Past and present with passive: (0) discovered - past simple; (1) had been removed - past perfect passive; (2) had been tampered - past perfect passive; (3) suspect - present simple; (4) helped - past simple; (5) is recovered - present simple passive in conditional; (6) will resign - future simple; (7) is being watched - present continuous passive.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: I (0) have never run (run) a marathon before today. By the twenty-mile mark, my legs (1) ________ (feel) like lead. I (2) ________ (think) about quitting when a spectator (3) ________ (hand) me a bottle of water. That small gesture (4) ________ (give) me the strength I (5) ________ (need). If I (6) ________ (not stop) for that drink, I (7) ________ (collapse). I am glad I (8) ________ (persevere).
explanation: Present perfect and past narrative: (0) have never run - present perfect; (1) felt - past simple; (2) was thinking - past continuous; (3) handed - past simple; (4) gave - past simple; (5) needed - past simple; (6) had not stopped - past perfect in conditional; (7) would have collapsed - conditional perfect; (8) persevered - past simple.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The countdown (0) began (begin) at T-minus ten. The astronauts (1) ________ (strap) into their seats long before the engines (2) ________ (ignite). This mission (3) ________ (take) three years to plan. Once the rocket (4) ________ (break) the atmosphere, the crew (5) ________ (experience) weightlessness. They (6) ________ (conduct) experiments for the next six months. It (7) ________ (hope) that their findings (8) ________ (revolutionize) space travel.
explanation: Past and future: (0) began - past simple; (1) had been strapped - past perfect passive; (2) ignited - past simple; (3) had taken - past perfect; (4) breaks - present simple after 'once'; (5) will experience - future simple; (6) will conduct - future simple; (7) is hoped - present simple passive; (8) will revolutionize - future simple.
